subject: Stratus / Redwood: joint architecture review & integration workshop
messages:
From: Sara Klein <sara.k@stratuscloud.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Tim O'Neal <tim.oneal@cloudmarket.io>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Stratus x Redwood - architecture review / joint workshop

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the brief intro last week — Stratus is excited to move toward a joint solution listing in CloudMarket. Our cloud partnerships team would like to run a focused architecture review and integration workshop to align on the deployment model, networking, and the marketplace packaging requirements.

High level ask: a 90-minute technical deep-dive with your infra/solutions engineers + our SI/partnership and procurement teams. Goals: confirm supported deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private/VPC), network requirements (peering, egress), and the marketplace packaging checklist that impacts the integration plan.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed Mar 4, 10:00–11:30
- Wed Mar 4, 15:00–16:30
- Thu Mar 5, 08:30–10:00

If none of those work, happy to share a Doodle. Can you also confirm who from Redwood should join and whether you have a short architecture brief we can review ahead of time?

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Klein
Partnerships Manager | Stratus Cloud
Sara.K@stratuscloud.com

--

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Sara Klein <sara.k@stratuscloud.com>

Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Stratus x Redwood - architecture review / joint workshop

Sara — thanks for the clear note. All good from our side; we can host the session and would prefer the Wed Mar 4 10:00–11:30 PT slot if that still works for your procurement folks.

Planned Redwood attendees: me (partner lead, overview & rollouts), Laura Bennett (Solutions Engineer — deployment/marketplace packaging), Marcus Lin (Infra/Network — VPC/peering & runtime constraints).

I'll circulate a short pre-read — attached is our architecture brief (high level) that covers the deployment modes and recommended integration patterns. Suggested 90-minute agenda:
1) 10 min intros & scope
2) 25 min Redwood runtime & deployment options (hosted / dedicated / private)
3) 25 min Stratus requirements & marketplace checklist
4) 20 min network/security/Q&A
5) 10 min next steps & action items

Questions for you ahead of time:
- Will this include procurement/provisioning (we saw "procurement" in your invite list)? If yes, can you confirm desired contract triggers (SLA, support term, dedicated capacity)?
- Any hard constraints on allowed regions (US west/east, EU)?

Attached: redwood-inference-architecture-brief.pdf (presentation/pdf) — it's a short 6-slide summary.

If Wed 10:00 is no good, we can move to Wed 15:00 — let me know.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Can we move to Wed Mar 4, 15:00–16:30 PT instead? Tim will join from CloudMarket and will want to cover listing/packaging constraints for marketplace publication (image formats, billing metering hooks).

I've attached a short workshop outline and the procurement checklist so you can scan for anything we should prep in advance. If Wed 15:00 is a problem for Redwood, please propose the next-best window.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Sara

Final draft agenda (90 min):
- 15:00–15:10: Introductions & success criteria (Olga / Sara)
- 15:10–15:35: Redwood runtime & deployment options (Laura) — hosting models, quantization & cost levers
- 15:35–15:55: Marketplace packaging & listing requirements (Tim) — image/packaging, metering hooks
- 15:55–16:15: Network & security deep-dive (Marcus) — VPC/peering, IP ranges, audit logs
- 16:15–16:25: Integration checklist & next steps
- 16:25–16:30: Action items and owners

Prep notes for Stratus: please share any required CIDR ranges, expected inbound IPs to whitelist, and the procurement SLA checklist you referenced so Laura can map packaging impacts to the contract terms.
